title: Core Deposit Schedule — Battery Replacement Warranties
content:
A refundable core deposit is held on a Crestline battery ticket when no old battery is handed in on that ticket. The deposit amount, the number of calendar days after the purchase date in which a core may be returned for the refund, where the refund goes and which cores are accepted are set per line of the Battery Replacement Warranties as follows.

| Line | Core deposit (USD) | Core return window (calendar days after the purchase date) | Refund goes to | Cores accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | 22.00 | 30 | the original tender | any lead-acid automotive battery |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | 22.00 | 30 | the original tender | any lead-acid automotive battery |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | 22.00 | 30 | the original tender | any lead-acid automotive battery |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | 22.00 | 30 | the original tender | any lead-acid automotive battery |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | 22.00 | 30 | the original tender | any lead-acid automotive battery |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 25.00 | 45 | the original tender | any lead-acid automotive battery |

**Points of the schedule.** The Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery is the one line with a different deposit (25.00 rather than 22.00) and a longer window (45 days rather than 30). On every line the refund goes to the original tender, and the core need not be the battery the new one replaced: any lead-acid automotive battery is accepted.
